title: Azusawa Kohane — Into An Exciting Future〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Geography Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, please break into your groups.

rows.Speaker: Geography Teacher
rows.Line: As I mentioned earlier, each group will select a country to research and produce a summary of information.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Alright, which country should we pick?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Hmm... None really stick out in my mind...
I kinda want a second to look at the books.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Then, let's take a minute to do that.
We can make a decision once we've had time to read more.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Okay! Let's all talk in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Okay, which country would be good?
France and the UK seem nice, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, this street has a huge graffiti mural!
It...looks a lot like that one we saw in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. It almost feels like I've been there before.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Where is this place? Let's see...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Los Angeles...
So, this is in the United States?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, speaking of the US...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I was just recently asked to do a US tour... And I plan to accept their offer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Taiga...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I wonder if he's going to perform in Los Angeles during his US tour...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(That day, at the airport...
We told him that we'd surpass RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We started performing at all these different events, visiting new places and battling against really tough opponents...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which taught us one thing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We're nowhere near catching up to Taiga yet.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No matter how good the teams we've faced have been... None of them have sung in a way that sends shivers down our spine. Not like him...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's clear that we've gradually gotten better compared to before. We've been practicing a ton and performing in so many events.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Still, I can't help but wonder what things are like from Taiga's point of view...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He probably sees things completely differently compared to us...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He knows what it's like on the other side of that wall.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, not just that.
He's gone far beyond that.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's how far we are from him.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We've made our decision.
We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and see what's beyond that wall.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We're going to see what Taiga hasn't. What Nagi didn't get a chance to...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And in order to accomplish that...we first have to get to where Taiga is.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have no idea how much singing that's going to involve...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But... It doesn't matter how wide the skill gap is.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because that frustration I felt that day... It's what keeps me moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (As long as I have this pain, it will continue to fuel me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I know it will.
I'm going to go so much further than I ever have...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(So, for now...
I'm going to embrace this pain.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And we're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND!)
